instructions: 1. Say the work in one plain sentence, for example "let bakery customers change a pre-order until the evening before pickup", and say "Run workflow:method-plan-only-what-helps" with it as request.

The AI starts it with tool:start-a-recipe-run (row workflow:method-plan-only-what-helps) and answers its steps in order: outcome, baseline, delete, owner, combine, smallest-change, risk, production, proof, focused-choice; each answer is refused until every check of the step is answered about this request.
3. Keep a section only when it helps: delete mirror checks and ceremony that makes work wait, and do every step you identify in the same pass.
4. At proof, give a test that could fail, a before and after view, and measured numbers where speed matters.
